Subject: Pilot request — short soft-reserve for edge testbed (Nov 22–Dec 13)

Hi Tessa,

We talked last week at the summit; thanks again for the quick demo. EdgeAI Labs is targeting a small live testbed to validate on-device quantized models and end-to-end latency under real user traffic. We have agreement from product + procurement to run a 3-week pilot and would like to request a soft-reserve (not a full committed contract) for additional GPU capacity in Redwood Dedicated. High-level ask: 12 A100-equivalent GPUs (prefer 80GB or quantized equivalents), weekdays Nov 22–Dec 13, with a controlled autoscale burst to 2x for scheduled nightly sweeps.

We understand this is outside standard reservations. Can Redwood provide a temporary carve (soft-reserve) + an exception to the autoscaling policy for the pilot window? We can sign a simple MOU and provide a short mutual action plan.

Attached: edge_test_plan.pdf (overview + expected token volumes).

Thanks,
Omar Khalid

Thanks for looping me in. Quick notes from Product:

- Fallback plan: we can expose a quantized 7B and a trimmed 13B variant with bounded quality delta; that should reduce memory needs to a mix of 40–60GB effective (depending on quantization).
- Soft-reserve definition: product is okay with a time-boxed carve if ops & infra accept the autoscale exception and we ensure observable regressions are captured.
- Question for EdgeAI: do they require persistent KV caches between runs, or can we accept cold starts nightly? If they need warm caches we should charge for the extra partial-hours.

I've attached a quick MAP template (mutual-action-plan.md) that we can send with the MOU. If Marcus confirms capacity and Michael can deliver a runbook, Product signs off.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Pilot window capacity check (us-west)

Short answer on capacity: we can probably accommodate 12 A100-eq for the requested window but with caveats. Current constraints and recommended guardrails: 

- Us-west pool utilization: baseline scheduled to be ~72% during that week due to queued enterprise jobs. We can carve up to 18 GPUs across the pool for short windows but prefer limiting any single pilot to <= 15% of the pool to avoid knock-on effect. 12 GPUs for 3 weeks is mildly disruptive but doable if we: 
  - Limit burst to 2x only for a nightly 2-hour maintenance sweep (explicit schedule).
  - Enforce pre-booked top-off windows (we'll block the lane 22:00–02:00 PST nightly).
- Autoscale exception: must be timeboxed and enforced via a policy flag. We need a signed MOU and an internal ticket (INF-784) that ties the exception to the deal_id.
- Ops handoff: I need Michael's runbook + a testrun 48hrs before the pilot starts to validate KV-cache priming.

If Product agrees to the fallback model and EdgeAI signs the MOU with the schedule, I'll raise the carve and annotate the pool.

Marcus Lin
Principal Infra Eng, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Hi Omar,

Thanks — good news. Internal alignment is positive pending a short MOU + a couple of operational items. Summary & next steps: 

1) Capacity & schedule (confirmed provisionally): Redwood will soft-reserve 12 A100-equivalent GPUs in the us-west Dedicated pool for Nov 22–Dec 13. Nightly scheduled burst allowed up to 2x for a 2-hour window (22:00–00:00 PST). Marcus will annotate the pool once we have the MOU.

2) Models & fallback: Product can provide a quantized variant (7B) and a trimmed 13B fallback. We recommend using the quantized variant as default during the pilot to minimize memory pressure and costs.

3) Runbook & validation: Michael (Ops) will need a runbook + access to a small smoke test 48 hours before start to prime caches. Please provide a brief acceptance test script (5–7 calls covering common user flows).

4) Commercials & MOU: Please review the attached MAP (mutual-action-plan.md). We can take a short MOU (one-page) that confirms schedule, the timeboxed autoscale exception, and liability limits. Once signed we'll convert to a short invoice for the pilot.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.md, reserved-lane-matrix.xlsx (proposed carve).

If this looks good I'll circulate a draft MOU and set a 30-minute kickoff on Nov 17 to walk through the runbook and test plan.

Best,
